description: Returns the product classes (e.g. dairy-eggs) whose index moved most, week on week, in one published week: the largest rises and falls, each with its matched-product count and a thinBase flag where a class rests on few products. Classes only: no retailers, no products, no prices. Index changes, not price changes paid; not a CPI. Omit vintage for the latest week.

direction.description: "up" for rises or "down" for falls. Omit for both.

limit.description: Classes per direction, 1 to 10. Omit for 5.

vintage.description: ISO week, e.g. "2026-W45". Omit for the latest published week.

name: get_class_movers
title: Product classes with the largest index moves
